verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports pausing/resuming agent runs (Esc to pause, resume previous conversations), switching between local/remote/cloud agents without losing focus, and multi-surface access (CLI, terminal, web GUI/Agent Canvas). This suggests a developer could take over across surfaces, but there is no explicit documented workflow describing mid-task handoff/redirection (e.g., editing agent's plan mid-run, injecting new instructions to redirect work) or cross-device continuity of a single in-progress task. missing for 10: explicit documentation of redirecting/steering an in-progress task (not just pause/resume), evidence of editor/IDE integration for takeover, and independent/hands-on confirmation of seamless handoff across surfaces.
